urban_evidence: Mauryan punch-marked coins across South Asia; polished pillars and capitals; expanding western trade; donor inscriptions
limits: Coin distribution indicates interaction not uniform monetization administration or direct control.

political_order: Kushanas Sakas Kshatrapas Satavahanas Cheras Cholas and Pandyas remained multiple regional powers
urban_evidence: Burnt-brick buildings; streets and drains; fortification walls; tiled roofs and floors; extensive coinage; inland and maritime trade
named_examples: Gandhara; Mathura; western Deccan; Sanchi; Bharhut; Nagarjunakonda; Amaravati; Kanaganahalli

limits: The broad phase joins asynchronous regional developments and does not imply one political or economic system.
